mission: As Desh lays the nodes, Ben walks through the forming field and realizes the infrastructure has become legible to him in a way it never was before, while Veraine's design logic reveals itself underfoot.
why_now: The climax needs this sensory lesson before it can rely on it. Ben has to acquire the node-sense here or the next chapter will feel like it invented a new tool mid-crisis.
conflict: Ben is learning something new in the worst possible place to stop and examine it. At the same time, the ground itself tells him he is walking through Veraine's thinking.
turning_point: Ben knows where the next node belongs before he sees it, and Sera's look tells him she knows he felt it too.
opening_hook: Desh is already moving ahead of them on the broken ground, the node-cases slung across his back and his datapad in one hand, setting the first of the nodes at a position he has spec'd down to the centimetre
closing_hook: They reach the mid-valley position. Desh is a hundred metres ahead, setting the sixth node. Ben can feel all six behind him without turning around. Sera's hand brushes his shoulder — not a gesture, a confirmation — and takes her position. Kael takes his. The plan is in place
emotional_trajectory: The approach's deliberate pace -> Desh working at the edge of hearing -> the nodes becoming audible as objects -> Veraine's signature felt underfoot -> the quiet arrival at the mid-valley position with a new capacity Ben does not yet know is new

stakes.personal: Ben acquiring — without announcement, without articulation — a Weave-sensing capacity that will carry the climactic legibility in Ch 25-26; Ben walking through the material thinking of his opponent and registering her as architect, not presence
stakes.interpersonal: Sera's reading the signature and meeting Ben's eyes without speaking — the second wordless exchange between them about Veraine's work (first: Ch 22 mast); the nascent Sera/Kael resonance already forming as an unplanned ambient condition of the approach
stakes.external: The containment nodes being placed and the array taking shape; the climactic environment confirmed as Veraine's design; the plan positioned and ready for s3

setting: Veranthos — mid-approach across the broken ground toward the mid-valley position, nodes being placed in a line ahead of the walking trio
sensory_details: The broken ground underfoot — basalt slabs tilted at angles that do not match any geological process Ben has seen before; Desh ahead with the node-cases, opening them with the economy of someone who has done the procedure on paper four hundred times; each node a matte cylinder the length of a forearm, its base-plate seating with a specific, quiet click when locked into position; the first node passing behind them — and a tone, faint, underneath the wind, in the shape of a held pitch Ben cannot quite name; the second node, a slightly different pitch; the third, a third; the three pitches not combining but sitting at a rhythm; the realisation that he knows where the next position is without looking — the next pitch already audible in the shape of the silence where it will sit; Sera half a pace behind his right shoulder, her own reading moving in parallel, her face the face she wore at the mast; the specific geometry of the node-spacing — not regular, not arbitrary, a logic under it that Ben's hand wants to trace in the air; the Scar visible ahead and below, Veraine's ritual a shape of organised pressure at its base, Torin descending the far ridgeline in peripheral vision; Kael walking at the line's edge, his presence in the Force gradually anchoring at a specific texture as the resonance's pre-conditions form
canon_elements_needed: Sith design-signature theory for Force-amplification architecture (continuity with Ch 22 s2 mast)
Weave-infrastructure sensing — the phenomenon of Force-registerable objects acquiring Weave-presence under adjacent resonance conditions
Non-Force-sensitive node-placement hardware (Desh's engineered containment hardware)
Brotherhood-of-Darkness inheritance conventions (for what Veraine's configuration deviates from)
action_beats: Desh moves ahead across the broken ground and begins setting the first containment node at its spec'd position — the node-case opening, the cylinder locking into its base, the quiet click
Ben, Sera, and Kael begin walking the approach line behind Desh; the first node registers in Ben's Force-sense as a faint held pitch underneath the wind
The second and third nodes pass behind them; the three pitches sit at a rhythm rather than combining; Ben notices that the noticing is new
At the third node, Ben realises — without looking — that he knows where the fourth position will be; Sera's eyes find his, confirm the same reading she is making; neither speaks
Ben feels the array configuration's design signature underfoot — the placement geometry, the inter-node rhythm, the architectural logic continuous with the mast Sera read at Ch 22
The trio reaches the mid-valley position; Desh is ahead, setting the sixth node; Sera's hand brushes Ben's shoulder and she takes her position; Kael takes his; the plan is in place
promises_planted: Ben's Weave-infrastructure-sensing capacity (plants Ch 24 s2; pays the Ch 25-26 climactic legibility of Desh running the guarded route via the nodes' Weave-presence)
promises_paid: Veraine's design-authorship of the climactic environment rendered through the array itself (pays W2 evidence-of-passage architecture beat 5 of 5 — closing the evidence-of-passage arc that began at Ch 17 s3)
notes: This is discovery through movement. Keep Desh real and physical, the nodes felt, and Veraine present only through design.

turning_point_detail.trigger: Ben realizes—without looking, without conscious inference—that he knows where the fourth node position will be. Sera's eyes find his in the same moment, confirming she is making the same reading.
turning_point_detail.shift: The scene pivots from Ben passively registering individual node-pitches to Ben actively sensing the array's overall design geometry. The pressure shifts from external (Desh working ahead) to internal (Ben's own emerging capacity). The dynamic becomes one of parallel discovery—Sera reading alongside him—rather than Ben following.
turning_point_detail.cost: Ben acquires a new sensory capacity he does not yet consciously recognize as new. This binds him to the climactic solution in Ch 25-26; he cannot unknow what the Weave now shows him. The cost to Sera is the second wordless exchange about Veraine's work, deepening the intimacy of their reading without articulation. The cost to the group is that Kael's presence begins anchoring at a specific texture as the resonance's pre-conditions form—an unplanned ambient condition that will shape the climax.

emotional_arc.start: Deliberate, focused pressure of the approach—Ben moving with intention but without full understanding of what he is about to discover.
emotional_arc.shift: The pressure tightens inward as Desh works at the edge of hearing and the nodes become audible as objects. Ben's attention narrows to what is changing in his own perception. When Sera's eyes meet his, the pressure transforms from solitary discovery into shared recognition.
emotional_arc.end: Quiet arrival at the mid-valley position. Ben carries a new capacity he does not yet know is new—a kind of calm readiness, the sensation of standing in a structure he can now feel beneath him. No triumph, no articulation. Just the ground made legible.

key_beats.beat_description: Desh moves ahead across the broken ground, the node-cases slung across his back, his datapad in one hand. He reaches the first spec'd position and opens the node-case with practiced economy. The matte cylinder locks into its base-plate with a specific, quiet click.
key_beats.state_change: The abstract mission becomes concrete. The approach shifts from planning into execution. The first anchor point is established.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben registers the click as a physical threshold crossed. His instinct pushes toward action rather than explanation—the deliberate pace of the approach tightens into focus. He is watching Desh work because Desh is the only one moving; the rest of them are walking into something they cannot yet see.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben, Sera, and Kael begin walking the approach line behind Desh. As they move, the first node registers in Ben's Force-sense as a faint held pitch underneath the wind—not a sound, but a presence that has a pitch-shape.
key_beats.state_change: The nodes transition from hardware to Force-registerable objects. The Weave-infrastructure begins to acquire presence. Ben's sensory field expands to include what Desh is building.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben's focus tightens on what just changed. The pitch is underneath everything else—underneath the wind, underneath the sound of their footsteps on the broken ground. It is there without being loud. His body registers it before his mind names it. A slight shift in his breathing as he adjusts to the new texture in the Force.

key_beats.beat_description: The second node passes behind them. Then the third. The three pitches do not combine into a chord; they sit at a rhythm instead—a spacing, a pattern, a logic under the placement. Ben notices that the noticing itself is new. He has never felt infrastructure this way before.
key_beats.state_change: The array begins to acquire design signature. Individual nodes resolve into a configuration. Ben's perception shifts from registering objects to reading architecture.
key_beats.pov_reaction: A moment of disorientation—Ben's hand wants to trace the geometry in the air, to map what his Force-sense is showing him. He does not do it. Instead, he walks and lets the pattern settle into his body. The realization that this capacity is arriving without his having asked for it. A slight tension in his shoulders as he adjusts to the weight of understanding something he did not know he was capable of understanding.

key_beats.beat_description: At the third node, Ben realizes—without looking, without conscious inference—that he knows where the fourth position will be. The next pitch is already audible in the shape of the silence where it will sit. Sera's eyes find his in the same moment. Her face carries the same reading she is making. Neither speaks.
key_beats.state_change: The turning point lands. Ben's perception crosses from passive registration into active prediction. Sera's silent confirmation transforms the moment from solitary discovery into shared recognition. The pressure shifts from external (Desh working ahead) to internal (Ben's own emerging capacity).
key_beats.pov_reaction: A sharp intake of breath—not audible, but Ben feels it in his chest. The moment when Sera's eyes meet his carries the weight of the second wordless exchange between them about Veraine's work. No need to speak. The reading is the same. Ben's body steadies as he understands that he is not alone in this perception. A brief, intense quiet between them—the kind of quiet that carries more than words.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben feels the array configuration's design signature underfoot as they walk—the placement geometry, the inter-node rhythm, the architectural logic continuous with the mast Sera read at Ch 22. The logic is not regular; it is not arbitrary. It is Veraine's thinking made material. Ben walks through her design and registers her as architect, not presence.
key_beats.state_change: The climactic environment is confirmed as Veraine-designed. The array's purpose and structure become legible through the Weave-infrastructure itself. Ben now carries the sensory knowledge he will need to navigate the climax.
key_beats.pov_reaction: A deep, settling calm. Ben's hand still wants to trace the geometry, but now he understands why—the pattern is asking to be read, and his body knows how to read it. No triumph, no articulation. Just the ground made legible beneath him. Kael's presence in the Force gradually anchors at a specific texture as the resonance's pre-conditions form—an ambient condition Ben registers but does not yet understand.

anti_patterns: Do not open with explanation or exposition about the nodes or the array's purpose
Do not have Ben articulate or name his new capacity—the capacity arrives without announcement, without articulation
Do not arrive at clinical articulation of the Force-perception; keep it sensory and experiential
Do not use diagnostic voice or mission-debrief sentences; the scene is movement and discovery, not briefing
Keep Desh real and physical; the nodes felt; Veraine present only through design
